items.title: 63477_Joe Darensbourg oral history interview
items.q: When I played with him, it was a matinee deal. You see, once in a while I played with him at night.

ctx.x: I think those records were made in 1924. Who else is on those darn records. Willie Humphrey was either playing tenor on some of them or some of those Dewey Jackson records. I'm not sure which.
Well, it wasn't Willie for sure. As a matter of fact, I never did play in his big band regular. When I played with him, it was a matinee deal. You see, once in a while I played with him at night.
And how did their music differ...
